independence: Separate agent. Reviewer did not author or repair RESOURCE_CHAINS, WORLD_VEHICLES or verify_economy; repairs were returned to their owner.
scope: Material recipe/catalogue/producer dependency and exact batch arithmetic; validator negative cases. No gameplay, balance, art, motion, sound or device approval.
repaired_finding: Misclassified world vehicle profile skipped funded initial tank validation. Builder added kind/binding gates; same mutation now rejects.
raw_subtotal_units: Legacy ledger bundles for wood/stone/metal/coal, distinct abstract crude liquid units. Never sum these as mass or multiply saved counts by10.

runtime_read_only_findings.finding: configure/payment/vehicle_repurchase/vehicle_pay_repair/_move_vehicle_goods still assume old raw or small product dictionaries. New processed costs and cargo require a coupled generic typed-custody/restore adaptation.
price_text iterates eight fixed IDs and uses int plus raw display*10. New bars/sheets/fuel/component lines would be omitted; use catalogue denominations and exact decimal formatting.
vehicle_repurchase blocks on nonempty ordinary salvage. Do not apply that condition to separate fractional fuel estates: recovery into a live tank otherwise creates a replacement deadlock.
